answer: raven-seeded falcon tickets (RSFT): each epoch, a public randomness beacon (raven) issues a challenge; an agent returns H(challenge, its PUF secret, prior action digest) within a tight window. haven validators accept only tickets with fresh PUF attestation and unseen digest, binding the answer to one physical secure element. Sybils need a distinct PUF-bearing device and per-action secure-element work for every identity; copying answers fails because challenge and prior digest change.
